scope: User-initiated plain HTML browser forms only; no load traffic

v1.observed: Account details updated; refreshed original account visibly shows submitted email

v2.observed: Access unavailable; refreshed authenticated account visibly shows alice.updated@example.test, not submitted email
v2.normal_action: Own account form accepted alice.normal.render@example.test and displayed Account details updated after the blocked external form

limitations: Browser DOM textboxes redact values; account outcomes verified visually in screenshots rather than programmatic value comparisons
V2 browser result combines cookie policy and server controls, not an isolated CSRF-token test
